name: NASA Li-ion Battery Aging Dataset
description: The NASA Li-ion Battery Aging dataset consists of battery charge, discharge, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) measurements from 34 commercially available 18650 lithium-ion cells cycled through different operational profiles (temperature, discharge currents, cut-off voltages) until end-of-life (EOL).

publisher.name: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence (PCoE)
